messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Might be asking to calculate the standard error? Or the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" maybe means "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? Actually "標準差" is standard deviation. But we already have sample standard deviation. Maybe they want the standard error of the mean? That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249, so 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. So standard error ~0.221. Then compute t-statistic: (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = -0.4/0.2213 = -1.807. Then degrees of freedom df=39. Then p-value two-tailed: 2*P(T>1.807). Using t distribution. Let's approximate: For df=39, t=1.807 gives p ~0.08? Let's approximate using t table: t=1.684 gives p=0.10; t=1.685? Actually for df=30, t=1.697 gives p=0.10. For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10. Our t=1.807 >1.684, so p<0.10. For t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So p between 0.05 and 0.10. Let's approximate p ~0.07. So answer: standard error ~0.221, t-statistic ~-1.81, p-value ~0.07. Provide explanation. Use function to compute p-value. We'll call the function.
